title: Confirm T4 seam activation stability and exit conditions
objective: Execute final verification that the narrow T4 activation path meets all Phase 26B exit conditions: confirm T4 correctly reads qualifying social events, emits minimal negative relational signals with valid contract, and produces stable, observable, auditable downstream gate behavior without architectural instability or test regressions.
exact_scope: IN: Running comprehensive verification tests to confirm T4 processes qualifying narrow social events; validating minimal negative relational AppraisalSignal emission shapes; auditing downstream residual creation gate interactions for stability and observability; verifying zero test regressions (maintaining 219+ passing tests); documenting exit condition verification results. OUT: Modifying T4 builder core logic, expanding event taxonomy beyond narrow approved path, adding new signal types or strong negatives, changing settlement/substrate/bridge architecture, implementing deferred tick bridges (T3/T5/T6/T7/T8), introducing LLM appraisal components.
constraints: Must maintain existing test suite at 219+ passing tests with zero regressions
Must constrain verification to the narrow social event path implemented in P26B-T1/T2
Must not expand T4 logic to handle broad relational modeling or routing by target_id
Must document any detected instability or edge cases for human review if found
acceptance_criteria: T4 activation seam correctly processes qualifying narrow social events in test scenarios
Minimal negative relational AppraisalSignals are emitted with valid contract and compose safely with existing T1/T2 signals
Downstream residual creation gates demonstrate observable, auditable behavior when receiving T4 signals
Existing test suite passes completely with no regressions
Exit condition verification results are documented confirming seam stability or specific findings
required_tests: test that T4 narrow activation path correctly reads qualifying social events and emits minimal negative relational signals
test that T4 signals compose safely with same-day T1/T2 signals without downstream gate conflicts
test that edge cases in social event detection boundaries do not cause unstable downstream behavior or hidden state mutations
non_goals: do not modify T4 builder implementation beyond verification necessities
do not expand event taxonomy or add broad relational modeling
do not refactor settlement, substrate, or bridge components
do not implement deferred tick bridges (T3/T5/T6/T7/T8)
do not introduce live LLM appraisal or shadow validation mode
